#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/work/gemm/glm53f-strata-20261001/a64fx/glm5"
work=$PWD/../../tmp/strata-mla-logits-20261003
bin=$PWD/build/candidate-mla-values-prescale-v2
[ ! -e "$bin" ]
mkdir -p "$bin"
export TMPDIR=$work OPAL_PREFIX=/opt/FJSVxtclanga/tcsds-1.2.43
unset OMPI_CC OMPI_CXX
cc=/opt/FJSVxtclanga/tcsds-1.2.43/bin/mpifccpx
flags=(-Nclang -O3 -march=armv8.2-a+sve -ffp-contract=fast -fopenmp -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I. -I../../common)
"$cc" "${flags[@]}" -ffast-math -fno-math-errno test_glm53f_mla_values_team.c -lm -o "$bin/test_glm53f_mla_values_team-fast"
"$cc" "${flags[@]}" test_glm53f_mla_values_team.c -lm -o "$bin/test_glm53f_mla_values_team-conservative"
sha256sum test_glm53f_mla_values_team.c glm53f_mla_absorb.h glm53f_mla_cache_f16.h "$bin"/test* > "$work/values-prescale-provenance-v2.sha256"
echo MLA_VALUES_PRESCALE_BUILD_PASS
driver_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/work/gemm/glm53f-strata-20261001"
logs=$PWD/tmp/strata-mla-logits-20261003
[ "${PJM_JOBID:-}" = 52138572 ] && [ "$PJM_NODE" = 12 ]
guard=$(date -d '2026-10-04 04:45:00 JST' +%s)
while ps -p 2857 -o args= | grep -q 'bash tmp/strata-mla-logits-20261003/driver-values-v1.sh'; do
 [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$guard" ] || exit 75
 sleep 10
done
grep -q '^MLA_VALUES_NATIVE_PASS$' "$logs/driver-values-v1.log" || exit 2
grep -q '^MLA_VALUES_PRESCALE_BUILD_PASS$' "$logs/build-values-prescale-v2.log" || exit 2
[ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$((guard-600))" ] || exit 75
if pgrep -f '[m]piexec|[p]lexec|[p]lspawn' > /dev/null; then
 echo 'REFUSE concurrent MPI after model prerequisite' >&2; exit 2
fi

export GLM53F_BUILD=0 GLM53F_GGUF=$HOME/models/glm53f-gguf-wide/UD-Q4_K_XL/GLM-5.3-Flash-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00006.gguf
export GLM53F_BIN_DIR=$PWD/a64fx/glm5/build/candidate-mla-values-prescale-v2 GLM53F_RUN_TAG=mtp-batch3-gates
export XOS_MMM_L_PAGING_POLICY=demand:demand:demand XOS_MMM_L_HPAGE_TYPE=none
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=47 OMP_PROC_BIND=close OMP_PLACES=cores OMP_WAIT_POLICY=active FLIB_BARRIER=HARD
export GLM53F_PREWARM=1 GLM53F_PROFILE=1 GLM53F_FAST_MATH=1 GLM53F_NO_MATH_ERRNO=1
export GLM53F_COMM_OWNER=0 GLM53F_SPARSE_ASYNC=0 GLM53F_NATIVE_Q8_PANEL=0 GLM53F_SPARSE_MLA_BATCH=1
export GLM53F_NATIVE_Q8_ROWS8=0 GLM53F_NATIVE_Q8_TILE2X8=0 GLM53F_MLA_FUSED_PROJECTION=0 GLM53F_MHC_FUSED_SYNC=0 GLM53F_MOE_GU_PAD=0
export GLM53F_EMBED_BATCH_PACKED=0 GLM53F_HEAD_VERIFY_SHARED=0 GLM53F_DENSE_PREFILL_TILE=4
fail(){ echo "error: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
source a64fx/glm5/scripts/glm53f_env.sh
source a64fx/glm5/scripts/glm53f_launch.sh
mkdir -p "$logdir" "$GLM53F_BUILD_DIR" "$logs/results"
# This synthetic MPI fixture has no model staging or tofu dependency.
for math in fast conservative; do
 binary="$GLM53F_BIN_DIR/test_glm53f_mla_values_team-$math"
 for threads in 1 47; do
  OMP_NUM_THREADS=$threads mpi_run "mla-values-prescale-$math-$threads" /usr/bin/numactl --interleave=4,5,6,7 "$binary"
  grep '^MLA_VALUES_TEAM .*BIT_EXACT PASS$' "$last_log".*.0
  cp "$last_log".*.0 "$logs/results/values-prescale-$math-$threads.log"
 done
done
echo MLA_VALUES_PRESCALE_NATIVE_PASS
